name: Run limit, queue place and automatic reduction
steps: Start with the person's limit at one while the host carries three steps
Observe the first-ranked goal start and the other two wait with their place and the slot reason
Set the limit to two and observe the next goal in rank start
Set it back to one and observe that both running steps continue and the last goal still waits
Return the limit to automatic while the host reports heavy load and observe the limit fall with the load reason
Free the host and observe the last goal start under the automatic limit
